name: sqldw-operations-cli
description: > Analyze Fabric Data Warehouse performance via the MCP execute_query tool and queryinsights views. Diagnose slow queries, SQL pool pressure, cache coldness, and recommend clustering keys. Triggers: "DW slow query analysis", "slowest queries warehouse", "queryinsights long running", "warehouse CPU resource consumers", "SQL pool pressure window", "pressure events warehouse", "DW cache warmth cold start", "cache warmth analysis", "warehouse cluster key recommendation", "cluster tables performance"
author: microsoft
summary_zh: 用于分析 Fabric 数据仓库性能的命令行工具，可定位慢查询、资源压力和冷缓存，并给出聚簇键优化建议。
